result.summary: Fixed the inBounds boundary check in src/bounds.ts to treat valid indices as 0 through length-1 (index < length instead of index <= length), so empty collections (length 0) have no valid index and index == length is out of bounds. This resolves both frozen counterexamples: {index:3,length:3} now returns false and {index:0,length:0} now returns false, while preserving the exported inBounds(index: number, length: number): boolean API.
